Payflow, a Spanish fintech startup, faced a challenge with chaotic and complicated expense management. Using multiple providers and shared company cards led to poor spending visibility, slow processes, and high fees on foreign currency transactions. They needed a centralized solution to gain control and support their growth.

By implementing Payhawk's corporate cards and expense management software, Payflow streamlined its processes. The solution provided automated receipt reconciliation via OCR, real-time spend visibility for budget control, and competitive exchange rates. Payhawk's integrations and scalability saved the team significant time and gave them the financial control needed to expand internationally.

A freelancer or a small business usually runs on a spreadsheet of customers, invoices made by hand, and a separate tool for payments. Nothing is connected, so nobody can quickly answer simple questions like who still owes money or which product sold best this month.

PayFlow puts customers, products, invoices, payments and reports in one place, and adds an assistant that can answer those questions in plain language. It was built as a team project in the Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative (DEPI).
Customers and products:
profiles, activity and revenue per customer; products with images, stock, SKUs and prices.
sales, revenue, customer and product reports over any date range, with charts and export to PDF, Excel and CSV.
the whole interface switches language and direction, and products and users store Arabic fields in the database.

Instead of subscription plans, PayFlow charges for what a business actually creates. The free tier covers 5 invoices, 3 products and 5 customers; beyond that each invoice, product and customer has a small unit price.
Every invoice, product and customer created is recorded as usage.
This keeps the product free for someone just starting out and makes the cost grow only as the business does.

The assistant is a single chat endpoint that receives the question together with the business's own data as context. A user can ask for the top-selling products this month, the overdue invoices, or a suggested price for a new product. It works with either OpenAI or Gemini, switched by configuration, so the product is not tied to one provider.

PayFlow is a three-tier application: a React and Vite frontend, an Express API, and MongoDB with Mongoose. Both the frontend and the API are deployed on Vercel, with the API running as serverless functions.
